rules: Generic resolve first (owner/ref/tenant), then query only Queryable subtype; external scalar adapter allows/allowsMany; model-required binding with null model rejected, no new Model from DI. Native grouped EXISTS positive whereHas/local scopes/groupedOR/whereIn/whereExists; invalid from/connection/root joins/select/unions/order/limit/terminal/replacement rejects. Core owns immutable owner/key/common AND; role filter runtime per contribution. Роль с пустым scopes() принимает только tenant-wide вклад; context-specific вклад требует принятого binding типа/класса. scopeRequired() запрещает tenant-wide/global-context вклад даже при inherit/required запросе C. Общие filters проверяют selected C до authority, role filters этой contribution только в её ветке. Common direct/PolicyOnly role/grant nullable. Typed filter class DI at operation, invalid removed class build diagnostic; fingerprint contains class configuration, no captured live runtime models/callbacks. Adapter registration immutable typed policy API D15§5.
guidance: V47 default/plugin/provider AND; Seller/Caller city filter cannot disqualify independent Analyst branch; admin common checks intact; actual target differs actor; direct/policy role=null. V112 user city/active changes same T fresh inputs, fields of current grant only. R18 scalar native shapes, R19 external scalar/no-query. V38/V39/V87/V103: explicit two operations/fibers A/B, isolated scope stack finally (execution-local carrier, singleton mutable stack forbidden); wrappers owners matrix.
